description: Delete a named organization work schedule profile. Users assigned to this schedule will fall back to the default schedule. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set. Admin role required.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

work_schedule_id.description: Id of the work schedule to delete.

name: delete_work_schedule
